response.sql: WITH overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(s.modindex) as overall_modindex FROM signals s),telescope_weather_groups AS (SELECT t.telescregistry, o.weathprofile, AVG(s.modindex) as avg_modindex, AVG(s.phaseshiftdeg) as avg_phaseshift FROM signals s INNER JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry INNER JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY t.telescregistry, o.weathprofile),filtered_groups AS (SELECT twg.weathprofile, twg.avg_modindex, twg.avg_phaseshift, oa.overall_modindex, twg.avg_modindex - oa.overall_modindex as difference FROM telescope_weather_groups twg CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE twg.avg_modindex > oa.overall_modindex)SELECT weathprofile, AVG(avg_modindex) as avg_modindex, AVG(avg_phaseshift) as avg_phaseshift, AVG(difference) as above_overall FROM filtered_groups GROUP BY weathprofile
